title: The Mug the Way You Like It
youtube_title: The Mug the Way You Like It | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Kavi notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a mug prepared the way you like it, not the way it is faster. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Kavi does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
